craft_notes: Sthāyin: tracking — heart to lips. Rows: place then passage. Read aloud: inward trail.

lines: In the sealing-yoga called the body's far end —
in the pair too, in the wheel — what, throat-faring from the heart 'twixt the breasts to the lip's verge, stays unvoiced.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatsammīlanayoge dehāntākhye ca yāmale cakre kucamadhyahṛdayadeśād oṣṭhānte kaṇṭhagaṃ yad avyaktam
